suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO vs Threading: When to Stop Blocking
suggestion.rationale: Leverages heavy search volume on asyncio vs threading to resolve a classic concurrency misconception, boosting retention through crystal-clear visual contrasts.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using threads for I/O bound Python code until you see how AsyncIO's single-threaded event loop actually handles 10,000 concurrent requests without blowing up your RAM.
